title: Single nested-open compatibility from restriction units
statement: Let $h:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and assume the derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category] on $X,Y$ and all their opens exist. Let $W\subseteq U$ be arbitrary opens of $Y$ and $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$. Use the fixed single-open comparisons $c_U,c_W$ and restriction adjunctions of [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data]. Write $\rho^X_{h^{-1}U,h^{-1}W}$ and $\rho^Y_{U,W}$ for the adjunction mates in [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. For the direct image [def-pc-derived-direct-image], $Rh_*(\rho^X(E))\,c_W(E)=c_U(E)\,\rho^Y(Rh_*E)$ in Lean composition order. No covering or intersection hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 08BV (lemma-exact-sequence-j-star), 08FE (lemma-restrict-direct-image-open) and 0D5T (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition); official Stacks pages read online

proof.text: Expand the nested restriction as its adjunction mate. Naturality of the nested exact-restriction comparison, followed by the U-adjunction left triangle identity, proves eta_U followed by rho equals eta_W. This is the proved private helper unit_comp_restriction.

The underived open pushforward is fully faithful (Scheme.Modules.restrictAdjunction fullyFaithfulROfIsIsoCounit) and preserves K-injectives by Adjunction.preservesKInjectiveComplexes. The source library full_rightDerivedFunctor and faithful_rightDerivedFunctor make derived open direct image fully faithful. Thus applying U-restriction to the derived U-unit is invertible; restrict further and apply NatIso.isIso_map_iff to schemeDerivedOpenRestrictionCompIso to obtain invertibility after W-restriction. This is the fully proved private helper isIso_smaller_unit.

Apply single-open unit compatibility at U. Since c_U is an isomorphism, W-restriction of Rh_* eta_X,U is an isomorphism by the preceding step. Apply the inverse W-adjunction Hom equivalence: cancellation of that restricted map proves that precomposition with Rh_* eta_X,U is injective for maps into the W-direct-image target (private cancel_into_right_adjoint). Precompose the required equation with this map. Functoriality, the mate-unit equations on X and Y, and single-open unit compatibility at W identify both sides with eta_Y,W. Cancel to obtain the desired equality.

proof_origin.note: Adjunction cancellation proves the nested compatibility from the single-open unit equation; all glue is formalized.

lean.statement:
theorem schemeMVOpenComparison_restriction
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (h : X ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ T : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (W U : Y.Opens) (hWU : W ≤ U) (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
    (schemeDerivedDirectImage h).map
        (schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction X (homOfLE (h.preimage_mono hWU))
          (schemeMVAdjunction X (h ⁻¹ᵁ U)) (schemeMVAdjunction X (h ⁻¹ᵁ W)) E) ≫
        (schemeMVOpenComparison h W E).hom =
      (schemeMVOpenComparison h U E).hom ≫
        schemeDerivedOpenDirectImageRestriction Y (homOfLE hWU)
          (schemeMVAdjunction Y U) (schemeMVAdjunction Y W)
          ((schemeDerivedDirectImage h).obj E)
